In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your

[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

# Research-Grade Carbon Nanotubes, Graphene, and Advanced Nanomaterials

Whether you’re a graduate student testing a new electrode chemistry or an R&D engineer scaling the
next battery system, you need [carbon nanotubes][69], [graphene][70], and advanced nanomaterials you
can build on — materials with specs that hold and results you can reproduce. For 21 years,
researchers and engineers have chosen our materials for exactly that.

[Shop the Catalog][71]
[Request a Quote][72]

## The Work You Came Here to Do

Your research or product is the work only you can do. The best materials disappear into the
background — doing exactly what the specifications promised — so you can focus on the rest.

When the materials work, your project succeeds. Papers hit their deadlines. Prototypes advance.
Production runs meet their targets. Your best hours go to the questions only you can answer.

## How to Work with Cheap Tubes

### 1. Find what you need.

Browse [100+ products in our catalog][73] — carbon nanotubes ([single-walled][74],
[multi-walled][75], [functionalized][76], [industrial grade][77]), [CVD graphene films][78],
[graphene oxide][79], [graphene nanoplatelets][80], [silver nanowires][81], and more. Each product
page shows full specs, characterization data, and microscopy images. If you don’t see exactly what
you need, [ask us][82]. If we can’t help, we’ll point you in the right direction.

### 2. Buy online or request a quote.

Standard research quantities ship from our catalog. Bulk orders, custom specifications, or
large-volume purchases get a [quote][83] within one business day.

### 3. Ship with full documentation.

Every order includes a Technical Data Sheet (TDS) and [Safety Data Sheet][84]. Typical lead time 2–5
business days from our Townshend, Vermont shipping facility.

## About Cheap Tubes

Cheap Tubes was founded in 2005 by Mike Foley in Townshend, Vermont. Mike needed nanomaterials for

## Carbon Nanotube Supplier

Continental Carbon Nanotechnologies, Inc., based in Houston, Texas, is a provider of high quality
Carbon Nanotubes & Carbon Nanotube Blends.

[Carbon Nanotubes][18] represent the next generation of raw materials useful in a wide range of
applications including electrostatic and thermal dissipation, electromagnetic shielding and
composite material constructions. CCNI offers a range of products:
* [Fullerene nanotubes][19] which have smaller diameters and better structural integrity than
  fibrils
* [Multi-wall carbon nanotubes][20] which are an excellent cost and processing compromise
* Classic [single-wall carbon nanotubes][21] manufactured via the HiPco^{™} process
* [Custom blends][22] of CNT and conductive carbon black to suit your unique application


### **Nanotube Manufacturing**

We can provide gram quantities of CNT for research or kilogram quantities for your developing
application. If you are ready to purchase a quality carbon nanotube product, then CCNI is ready to
deliver.

#### **Nanotube Technology**

CCNI employs various manufacturing technologies and industry-leading expertise to produce
high-performance, cost-effective carbon nanotube (products a nanostructured form of the highly
abundant element) for the electronics, energy and materials industries.

##### **Nanotube Properties**

Discovered in the early 1990’s and later pioneered by Nobel Laureate Richard Smalley, CNTs have a
unique structure that gives them extraordinary electrical and mechanical properties, including a
current-carrying capacity per unit area that is one thousand times greater than copper and a tensile
strength that is fifty times greater than steel. Such properties make CNTs a highly promising
material for a wide variety of current and future applications.

###### **Nanotube Applications**

Although CCNI is currently focused on providing tubes to the CNT electronics industry, its grade
slate offerings broadly cover many other promising CNT applications, ranging from structural
composites to sensors to thermal dissipation.

[[carbon black company]][23]

**Interested In Other Carbon Materials?**
CCNI’s affiliate company Continental Carbon Company, a world leading supplier of carbon blacks also
produces other carbon materials such as conductive carbon blacks. These conductive blacks can be
used as-is or custom blended with carbon nanotubes. [Contact us][24] for more information or visit
the [CCC website][25].

[**Carbon Products**][26]

[[technical advice on nanotubes]][27]

**Technical Advice**
CCNI has highly dedicated specialists who can assist with your application. We can offer advice on
blending, dispersions, or selection of the most appropriate grade for your application. [Contact
us][28] for more information.



[**Need help with your application?**][29]

[[carbon nanotube]][30]

**CCNI HISTORY**
Our Legacy and Heritage. From its storied inception to its varied manifestations, CCNI is the real
deal. The heart of CNI is alive and well at CCNI!




[**Our History**][31]

## Carbon Nanotube Supplier

Continental Carbon Nanotechnologies, Inc., based in Houston, Texas, is a provider of high quality
Carbon Nanotubes & Carbon Nanotube Blends.

[Carbon Nanotubes][18] represent the next generation of raw materials useful in a wide range of
applications including electrostatic and thermal dissipation, electromagnetic shielding and
composite material constructions. CCNI offers a range of products:
* [Fullerene nanotubes][19] which have smaller diameters and better structural integrity than
  fibrils
* [Multi-wall carbon nanotubes][20] which are an excellent cost and processing compromise
* Classic [single-wall carbon nanotubes][21] manufactured via the HiPco^{™} process
* [Custom blends][22] of CNT and conductive carbon black to suit your unique application


### **Nanotube Manufacturing**

We can provide gram quantities of CNT for research or kilogram quantities for your developing
application. If you are ready to purchase a quality carbon nanotube product, then CCNI is ready to
deliver.

#### **Nanotube Technology**

CCNI employs various manufacturing technologies and industry-leading expertise to produce
high-performance, cost-effective carbon nanotube (products a nanostructured form of the highly
abundant element) for the electronics, energy and materials industries.

##### **Nanotube Properties**

Discovered in the early 1990’s and later pioneered by Nobel Laureate Richard Smalley, CNTs have a
unique structure that gives them extraordinary electrical and mechanical properties, including a
current-carrying capacity per unit area that is one thousand times greater than copper and a tensile
strength that is fifty times greater than steel. Such properties make CNTs a highly promising
material for a wide variety of current and future applications.

###### **Nanotube Applications**

Although CCNI is currently focused on providing tubes to the CNT electronics industry, its grade
slate offerings broadly cover many other promising CNT applications, ranging from structural
composites to sensors to thermal dissipation.

[[carbon black company]][23]

**Interested In Other Carbon Materials?**
CCNI’s affiliate company Continental Carbon Company, a world leading supplier of carbon blacks also
produces other carbon materials such as conductive carbon blacks. These conductive blacks can be
used as-is or custom blended with carbon nanotubes. [Contact us][24] for more information or visit
the [CCC website][25].

# Pioneering the Charge

[
][1]

## Leading the Way for Carbon Nanotube Technology

## Mission

Our tiny technology delivers major impact

##### We are a worldwide leader in carbon nanotubes, a key component of the lithium-ion batteries
##### used to power mobility advanced energy storage for today and tomorrow.
##### 
##### As a global company, we intend to be a good corporate citizen, with a commitment to safety,
##### environmental stewardship, and to the communities where we operate.

[ABOUT US][2]

## Solutions at Scale

The power of X

##### 15,000x thinner than a human hair, 10x to 100x more conductive that typical additives today,
##### and 2x more conductive than pure copper, our carbon nanotube pastes unlock unprecedented gains
##### in battery performance demanded by leading U.S. EV manufacturers as they supply consumers
##### worldwide.

01

### Our U.S.-based production will deliver savings to our customers. 

Major U.S. based EV automakers rely on Cnano USA for their carbon nanotube based conductive battery
materials. The on-shoring of our production at a new facility will reduce the cost to U.S. based EV
manufacturers and the US consumers.

02

### New capabilities that deliver new capacity

As the world leader in carbon nanotube and conductive pastes, Cnano USA is bringing a critical
technology to the U.S. that is not currently available, thereby adding hundreds of American
manufacturing jobs and bolstering the U.S. supply chain.

03

### Specialized manufacturing for a stronger U.S. supply chain

By establishing a major manufacturing center in the U.S., we're not simply enhancing the domestic
supply chain, but rather we are establishing the first CNT production capabilities at the scale
necessary to support the U.S. automotive industry. This also means we are equipping and training a
new generation of American tech workers, and thereby opening the door to American innovation.  

## Doing what we do best

#### Global Leader

Cnano is the leader in the field, producing more CNT based conductive additives than any other
company.

#### Quality & Technology

In the worldwide supply of CNT, Cnano USA is committed to the production of the highest quality CNT
within its facilities.  

#### New U.S. Investment

With our new 300,000 sq. ft. facility Cnano USA will invest over $100 million in plant, equipment,
and employees.

#### New Jobs

Cnano USA’s real investment is with people, creating over 100 new high tech jobs and supporting the
local economy. We have already provided jobs for over 160 people and many more contractors in the
construction of our new facility.

Yuyao Deyu Plastic Technology Co., Ltd. is a professional modified plastic pellet production
factory. The company provides complete production and quality control systems for customized plastic
modification, covering engineering plastic compounding, color matching, modification and
pelletizing.

DEYU focuses on electrically conductive plastics, antistatic / ESD plastic pellets, wear-resistant
and abrasion-resistant plastic pellets, carbon fiber reinforced plastic pellets, glass fiber
reinforced plastic pellets, UV-resistant plastics, low-temperature impact-resistant plastics,
plastic alloy compounds, light-shielding plastics and flame-retardant plastic compounds. Base resins
cover common plastic systems such as ABS, PP, PE, PC, PA, POM, PBT and PVC, while high-performance

and PSU.

Everything you need to know about eChemNetwork, business listings, chemical suppliers,

## ? What is eChemNetwork?

eChemNetwork is a global B2B platform connecting chemical, pharmaceutical, industrial, laboratory,
engineering, manufacturers, suppliers, exporters, importers, distributors, buyers, and service
providers worldwide.

## ? Is registration free?

Yes. Companies can create a business profile free of charge. Premium membership and advertising
plans are available for additional exposure and lead generation.

## ? How can buyers contact suppliers?

Buyers can search products or companies and submit inquiries directly through supplier profile pages
and product listings.

## ? Can I advertise my company?

Yes. eChemNetwork offers Featured Listings, Banner Advertising, Sponsored Products, Digital
Marketing, Email Marketing, and various branding opportunities.

Chemical, Pharmaceutical, API, Agrochemical, Petrochemical, Laboratory, Specialty Chemicals,

# EMFUTUR Advanced Corporation S.L. is a premier **advanced materials supplier** specialized in
# high-purity carbon nanostructures, functionalized fullerenes, and organic electronics.

## EMFUTUR: Beyond the Future

A premier deep-tech provider of high-purity carbon nanostructures, functionalized fullerenes, and
advanced polymers for electronics, pharmaceuticals, and biotechnology. We deliver validated chemical
solutions at any scale—from milligrams for research to bulk industrial production.

[Our Products][25]
[Get started today][26]
[Discover more][27]

## High-Purity Materials Validated by Global Science

### A Global Advanced Materials Supplier for High-Tech Industries. For over 15 years, we have
### bridged the gap between raw laboratory discovery and industrial-scale manufacturing. Our carbon
### allotropes and specialized polymer matrices are systematically cited in peer-reviewed scientific
### papers and global patents, providing a foundation of absolute batch-to-batch consistency and
### strict Certificate of Analysis (CoA) compliance.

### High-Purity Nanocarbons & Polymers

Our specialized chemical catalog features ultra-pure fullerenes (C60, C70), functionalized
derivatives, and advanced polymers tailored across three strategic industries: organic
optoelectronics (Fullerium™), biomedical R&D (Neurobium™), and high-end dermo-cosmetics (Lumerium™).

### Advanced Matrix Formulation

We provide custom surface functionalization, specialized organic chemical synthesis, and stable
solution dispersions—including bio-compatible water-soluble fullerenols and premium cosmetic-grade
matrices—precisely engineered to fit your strict laboratory or formulation parameters.

### End-to-End Scalable Supply

Supporting your timeline from foundational R&D to full mass-market execution. Backed by our official
factory-direct alliance, we deliver premium organic and bio-compatible materials in precise scaling
increments, from academic milligram validation to bulk industrial manufacturing volumes.

## Trusted by Leading Research Institutes & Global Industries

From custom laboratory samples to bulk industrial volumes, we meet the world’s most demanding
technical standards.

[Request a Quote][28]

## Why Choose EMFUTUR?

We deliver world-class advanced materials backed by premium quality assurance, custom synthesis
options, and an elite global distribution network to keep your research moving forward.


## Certified High Purity & Academic Reliability

[Download Catalog][29]

Every batch is rigorously verified at our facilities to ensure total absence of trace impurities and
peak performance. As the Official European Distributor for SolarisChem Inc. (Montreal, Canada),
EMFUTUR operates as a trusted **advanced materials supplier**, guaranteeing streamlined pan-European
customs clearance, stable stock inventory, and direct factory-to-laboratory technical coordination
for both academic research centers and large-scale manufacturing plants.

OFFICIAL EUROPEAN SOLARISCHEM HUB

## Advanced Organic Photovoltaics & Fullerene Architecture

Direct access to premium-grade, high-mobility electron acceptors for next-generation solar
architecture and organic electronics. Our technical portfolio features ultra-pure Fullerenes (C60
and C70), soluble Fullerenols, and industry-standard derivatives such as PCBM and ICBA, fully
optimized to secure high open-circuit voltage and excellent fill factors.

[EMFUTUR Advanced Materials Supplier abstract carbon nanotechnology matrix banner.]

HIGH-MOBILITY ELECTRONIC POLYMERS

## Premium Triarylamine Matrices & PTAA Configurations

Engineered for superior stability and optimized hole-transport performance (HTM) in perovskite solar
cell layers and OLED workflows. We supply highly curated amorphous p-type polymers, including
standard PTAA [CAS: 1333317-99-9], deeper HOMO level Fluoro-PTAA, and poly-TPD [CAS: 472960-35-3],
backed by certified molecular weight consistency.

your engineering and research teams to ensure seamless integration and optimal performance.

[Encyclopedia MDPI is thrilled to announce significant enhancements to its Academic Video Service,
which aim to improve its quality, accessibility, and functionality. Since its launch, our video
service has enabled numerous scholars to present their research in a dynamic and visually engaging

this service has received, we have reached a point where the number of orders we are receiving
exceeds our current capacity. In order to maintain the quality of these videos and continue

average. 1. Highlights of the Upgrades to the Service Although the service will now be fee-based, we
are committed to providing even more professional and comprehensive support, including the
following: One-on-one video production guidance Personalized assistance to ensure your needs are
fully met. Scriptwriting and English editing Expertly crafted narratives and professional English
editing to ensure your research is presented clearly, accurately, and with impact. High-quality
animations Visually engaging animations are created to simplify complex research and captivate your
audience. Whiteboard Animations: Clean and minimalist, using hand-drawn illustrations to explain
ideas step-by-step. Motion Graphics (MG) Animations: Cartoon Style: Bright, colorful, and
approachable, ideal for making technical or scientific content more accessible and engaging.

clarity and professionalism. Customized infographics (optional) We can also create tailored
infographics to visually summarize key data or findings, enhancing the clarity and appeal of your
video. Native voiceover Native speakers provide voiceovers to enhance the accessibility and reach of
your research. Multiple rounds of revision To ensure your video accurately represents your work.

Impact of Video Abstracts Research shows that a well-crafted video abstract can significantly

paper views by 120% （Source: 10.1007/ s11192-019-03108-w） Boost citations by 20% （Source: Wiley

to explain the specific aspects of your research. Regular Price: 5

[Where Do Sutureless Valves Fit in Modern Aortic Valve Surgery?][33]
[Aortic valve replacement remains one of the most commonly performed procedures in cardiac surgery
for treating severe aortic valve disease. While conventional surgical aortic valve replacement
(SAVR) continues to provide excellent long-term outcomes, advances in both surgical techniques and
transcatheter therapies have expanded the range of treatment options available to patients. Among
these developments, sutureless aortic valve replacement (SuAVR) was introduced to simplify valve
implantation by reducing the need for multiple sutures, with the goal of shortening operative time
and facilitating minimally invasive surgery. More than a decade after its introduction, clinical
experience with sutureless valves has grown substantially. At the same time, rapid progress in
transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) and continued refinements in conventional surgery have
reshaped the treatment landscape. A recent study published in the Journal of Clinical Medicine,
titled "Exploring Use-Rates of and Scientific Evidence on Sutureless Devices in Aortic Valve
Replacement: A Bibliographic Meta-Analysis and Clinical Considerations", reviews the current
evidence surrounding SuAVR, examines how its use has evolved across different regions, and discusses
where the technique may fit within contemporary cardiac surgery. Figure 1. Use and Evidence of
Sutureless Aortic Valves. Produced by MDPI Academic Video Service (Source:
https://encyclopedia.pub/video/1831). 1. Why Sutureless Valves Were Developed Conventional surgical
valve replacement requires the prosthetic valve to be secured with multiple sutures, a process that
contributes to aortic cross-clamp and cardiopulmonary bypass times. Because longer operative times
are associated with increased surgical risk, particularly in elderly patients and those with
multiple comorbidities, techniques that simplify valve implantation have attracted considerable
interest. Sutureless valves were developed to address this challenge. By reducing the number of
sutures required during implantation, they may simplify the procedure while maintaining the
principles of surgical valve replacement. The technology also complements minimally invasive
surgical approaches, where the limited operative field can make conventional suturing more
technically demanding. For these reasons, SuAVR attracted considerable attention as a potential way
to improve procedural efficiency while preserving the established benefits of surgical valve
replacement. 2. What the Current Evidence Suggests Over the past decade, a substantial body of
clinical evidence has accumulated on sutureless valve implantation. To better understand how this
evidence has evolved, the authors systematically reviewed 538 published studies on SuAVR. The
analysis showed that most of the available evidence comes from observational studies, while
randomized controlled trials account for only 1.3% of the published literature. Although SuAVR has
been investigated extensively, the limited availability of randomized evidence means that important
clinical questions remain incompletely answered. Across the published literature, one of the most
consistent findings is that SuAVR is associated with shorter aortic cross-clamp and cardiopulmonary
bypass times than conventional SAVR. These procedural advantages may be particularly relevant in
patients undergoing minimally invasive surgery or in those for whom reducing operative time is
desirable. At the same time, the paper notes that concerns remain regarding long-term valve
durability, pacemaker implantation, and procedural costs. These issues continue to influence how the
technology is evaluated and adopted in clinical practice. 3. Clinical Use Has Continued to Evolve
Although research on SuAVR has expanded considerably, its global clinical adoption remains
relatively limited. The paper found that approximately 80% of the published literature originated
from Europe, whereas North America contributed fewer than 10% of publications, highlighting a marked
geographical imbalance in both research activity and clinical use. The authors suggest that this
pattern may reflect a combination of factors, including earlier regulatory approval in Europe,
differences in reimbursement policies, and variation in patient populations. At the same time, the
rapid expansion of TAVR has transformed the treatment of aortic valve disease, while conventional
SAVR has continued to evolve through refinements in surgical techniques and prosthetic valve
technology. Against this background, SuAVR has assumed a more selective role rather than becoming a
universal alternative. The authors suggest that SuAVR may offer its greatest clinical value by
facilitating minimally invasive surgical aortic valve replacement, an approach that remains
underutilized in many parts of the world despite its potential benefits in appropriately selected
patients. 4. Finding a Place Alongside SAVR and TAVR As treatment options for aortic valve disease
continue to expand, selecting the most appropriate intervention increasingly depends on individual
patient characteristics, anatomical considerations, surgical risk, and procedural goals. Rather than
replacing existing approaches, SuAVR has become one of several treatment options available to
cardiac surgeons. Its potential advantages are most relevant in selected clinical settings,
highlighting the importance of individualized decision-making when planning valve replacement. 5.
What Comes Next for SuAVR? The study emphasizes that additional high-quality comparative trials are
needed to strengthen the evidence base for SuAVR. More standardized clinical guidance will also be
important for better defining the role of this technology within modern valve therapy. Meanwhile,
advances in conventional surgery, transcatheter interventions, and prosthetic valve technology will
continue to shape the management of aortic valve disease. As these treatment options evolve, careful
patient selection will remain central to choosing the most appropriate therapeutic approach. 6.

evidence has evolved, the authors systematically reviewed 538 published studies on SuAVR. The
analysis showed that most of the available evidence comes from observational studies, while
randomized controlled trials account for only 1.3% of the published literature. Although SuAVR has
been investigated extensively, the limited availability of randomized evidence means that important
clinical questions remain incompletely answered. Across the published literature, one of the most
consistent findings is that SuAVR is associated with shorter aortic cross-clamp and cardiopulmonary

patients undergoing minimally invasive surgery or in those for whom reducing operative time is
desirable. At the same time, the paper notes that concerns remain regarding long-term valve
durability, pacemaker implantation, and procedural costs. These issues continue to influence how the
technology is evaluated and adopted in clinical practice. 3. Clinical Use Has Continued to Evolve
Although research on SuAVR has expanded considerably, its global clinical adoption remains
relatively limited. The paper found that approximately 80% of the published literature originated
from Europe, whereas North America contributed fewer than 10% of publications, highlighting a marked
geographical imbalance in both research activity and clinical use. The authors suggest that this
pattern may reflect a combination of factors, including earlier regulatory approval in Europe,
differences in reimbursement policies, and variation in patient populations. At the same time, the
rapid expansion of TAVR has transformed the treatment of aortic valve disease, while conventional

facilitating minimally invasive surgical aortic valve replacement, an approach that remains
underutilized in many parts of the world despite its potential benefits in appropriately selected

cardiac surgeons. Its potential advantages are most relevant in selected clinical settings,

[Read more][78] 18 December 2025 ##### 20 Years of Open Access Books: A Milestone for IntechOpen Over the past two decades, IntechOpen has grown into a global leader in open access book publishing, with an ever-expanding catalogue covering STM, as well as the social sciences and humanities. [Read more][81] 25 March 2025 ##### ResearchGate and IntechOpen Announce New Journal Home Partnership As part of our ongoing commitment to expanding the reach and visibility of open access research, we are excited to announce a new partnership with ResearchGate, the leading professional network for researchers. This collaboration will increase the reach and brand visibility of our journals through ResearchGate’s Journal Home platform. Marshall, this book offers insightful research and novel approaches, contributing to the continuous discourse on *Helicobacter pylori*-related research. [Read more][84] 11 March 2024 ##### IntechOpen Signs Open Access Institutional Agreement with Iowa State University IntechOpen signs an institutional agreement with Iowa State University of Science and Technology to support open access and cover open access publishing fees for their faculty. [Read more][85] 07 June 2023 ##### IntechOpen Becomes a UKSG Member IntechOpen is now an official member of the UKSG, the UK's largest scholarly communications community. Founded almost half a century ago, it connects the knowledge community and encourages the exchange of ideas in scholarly communication. [Read more][86] 28 March 2023 ##### IntechOpen Book Wins the 2022 International Academy of Astronautics Life Science Book Award We are thrilled that the International Academy of Astronautics has chosen IntechOpen's book "Preparation of Space Experiments", edited by Dr. Vladimir Pletser, to receive the IAA Life Science Book Award. The award is given annually to recognize excellence in publication by an Academy member or corresponding member in the field of life sciences. ### Beyond Heat: The Physics and Psychology of Purity in a Vacuum Tube Furnace

Explore the operational physics of vacuum tube furnaces, where creating a void is as crucial as
applying heat for advanced material synthesis.

Read more →

### Mastering the Void: The Tube Furnace and the Science of Purity

Discover why the true power of a tube furnace lies not just in its heat, but in its ability to
create a perfectly controlled atmosphere for sensitive materials.

Read more →
][183] [

### The Glass at its Limit: Why Your 1200°C Furnace Tube Fails Below Spec

The 1200°C rating on a quartz tube is a starting point, not a guarantee. Discover why atmosphere,
time, and stress dictate its true limit.

Read more →
][184] [

### The Unseen Flaw: Why Uniform Density Is Everything in Powder Metallurgy

Traditional pressing creates hidden flaws. Cold Isostatic Pressing (CIP) uses uniform pressure to
achieve perfect density, ensuring component integrity.

Read more →
][185] [

### Perfection vs. Purpose: The Engineer's Choice Between Hot and Cold Pressing

Explore the metallurgical choice between hot and cold pressing—a decision between achieving absolute
density and engineering intelligent porosity.

Read more →
][186] [

### Beyond Temperature: The Art of Control in Thermal Processing

Discover why precise atmospheric and thermal control in a tube furnace, not just heat, is the key to
repeatable material science breakthroughs.

Read more →
][187] [

### Why Your High-Strength Components Fail—And the Secret to Ultimate Reliability

Experiencing unexpected material failures? Discover why standard alloys fail and how a process
called VAR ensures ultimate reliability for critical applications.

Read more →

near-perfectly dense ceramics with superior strength.

How Can We Help?

Your global business partners for addressing legal, scientific, and regulatory challenges.

## Competitive Advantage

Bergeson & Campbell, P.C. (B&C^{®}), is a Washington D.C. law firm focusing on conventional,
biobased, and nanoscale industrial, agricultural, and specialty chemical product approval and
regulation, product defense, and associated business issues. 

We help companies that make and use chemicals commercialize their products, maintain compliance, and
gain competitive advantage as they market their products throughout the world. Our Mission is to get

# About us

Our team

When you choose us, you choose the manufacturer, bypassing the middleman. Our team consists of
specialists with more than 10 years of practical experience and more than a 100 completed projects.
Many scientific publications in leading Russian and foreign media belong to our employees.

Our company

Our company produces and supplies functional [nanomaterials][34] (nanoparticles and nanopowders) for
the research and development purposes of our customers, participates in the development of new
materials used in various industries.

Scientific research

The development of new products always begins with scientific research. Our specialists are
qualified both for carrying out research and scientific analysis in any field of fundamental
science, as well as introduction of new technologies in production.

## Nanocyl provides high quality Carbon Nanotube (CNT) solutions that improve the properties of
## **your material** such as ESD/electrical conductivity, mechanical reinforcement, thermal

# News

Jan. 30, 2026

## K-Show-2025

Nanocyl will participate to the K-Show 2025 - Düsseldorf, Germany Meet us and visit our stand in
Hall 8a / J29 To discover the program and the exhibitors --> https://www.k-online.com/...
[[Read more]][23]

## Our products

Nanocyl core business is carbon nanotubes (CNT) production at industrial scale for more than 20
years. NC7000™ powder is the industrial CNT which is used for electrical conductivity or dissipative
behavior for Electronic, Transportation, Energy Storage and Industrial applications. Nanocyl also
developed a strong knowledge and knowhow on its CNT dispersions. Various polymer dispersions are
available on commercial range; into thermoplastics and thermosets (epoxy, rubber, polyol, silicone,
…), and also into liquid media: water and solvent (NMP) for coatings and energy storage

[Metallic][44] Solutions.**

customers with carbon nanotubes, graphene and nanomaterials that deliver breakthrough results.

Featured Article: [David Trimble][6]
Lord Trimble official portrait, 2018
**William David Trimble, Baron Trimble,** PC (October 15, 1944 - July 24, 2022), was a politician
from [Northern Ireland][7] who served as leader of the Ulster Unionist Party (UUP) and the first
First Minister of Northern Ireland. He shared the 1998 [Nobel Peace Prize][8] with [John Hume][9] of
the Social Democratic and Labour Party. On June 6, 2006, he became a member of the House of Lords as
The Right Honourable William David Trimble by the name, style and title of Baron Trimble, of
Lisnagarvey in the County of Antrim. Although a staunch [Protestant][10] and member of the Orange
Order, Trimble was able to reach across both the religious and the political divide to enter peace
negotiations and to agree a new power-sharing system of governance.
Popular Article: [Ion][11]
The Earth's "plasma fountain," showing [oxygen][12], [helium][13], and [hydrogen][14] ions that gush
into space from regions near the Earth's poles. The faint yellow material above the [North Pole][15]
represents gas lost from Earth into space; the green material is the aurora borealis—or [plasma][16]
energy pouring back into the atmosphere.
An **ion** is an [atom][17], group of atoms, or [subatomic particle][18] with a net electric charge.
An ion with a net positive charge is called a **cation**; one with a net negative charge is called
an **anion**. The atoms of [metals][19] tend to form cations, and the atoms of [nonmetals][20] tend
to form anions, but there are some exceptions. Ions of opposite charges attract each other. When a
cation forms a chemical bond ("ionic bond") with an anion, an **ionic compound** is produced. A body
of ionized matter, or a gas containing a proportion of charged particles, is called a
**[plasma][21]**.
Did you know?

True matriarchal societies were, and are, extremely rare (source: [Matriarchy][22])

## NoPo Nanotechnologies 

Specialises in manufacturing small diameter single-walled carbon nanotubes (SWCNT) for applications
ranging from electronics, sensors, semiconductors, EV batteries, medical, filtration and others. One
of the few players globally to produce small diameter 0.8-1 nm nanotubes at scale, we work closely
with our industry partners to develop suitable applications leveraging the many advantages of
nanotubes.

HiPCO® in Your World

Carbon Nanotubes produced by patented HiPCO® (High-Pressure Carbon Monoxide) produces high purity,
small diameter nanotubes of consistent quality to meet the requirement of various applications. The

#### Product Categories

SAT NANO is a professional supplier of nano powder and micro powder. Its products include metal
powder, oxide powder, carbide powder, nitride powder and other powders.

  SLM metal sintering printing, SLS nylon sintering printing, MJP high-precision resin printing,
  HSLA laser curing printing, SLA laser curing printing
* [[Element nanopowder]][180]
  
  #### [Element nanopowder][181]
  
  Supply copper, silver, Zinc, Iron, Titanium, Nickel, Tungsten, Stannum, Molybdenum, Boron, Cobalt
  nanopowder. They are with nano-sized particle size, strict particle size control, high sphericity,
  small agglomerated particles, and concentrated particle size distribution.

  Supply silica, tungsten oxide, zinc oxide, titanium oxide, zirconium dioxide, iron oxide, copper

  control, high sphericity, small agglomerated particles, and concentrated particle size
  distribution.

  particle size distribution.

  with nano-sized particle size, strict particle size control, high sphericity, small agglomerated
  particles, and concentrated particle size distribution.
* [[Carbide nanopowder]][188]

  Carbide nanopowder: Supply Molybdenum carbide, Chromium carbide, Zirconium carbide, Tungsten
  carbide, Titanium carbide, Boron carbide nanopowder. They are with nano-sized particle size,
  strict particle size control, high sphericity, small agglomerated particles, and concentrated
  particle size distribution.
* [[Nanopowder dispersion]][190]

  with nano-sized particle size, strict particle size control, high sphericity, small agglomerated
  particles, and concentrated particle size distribution.
* [[Multi oxide nanopowder]][192]
  
  #### [Multi oxide nanopowder][193]

* Permanent and stable anti-static properties without “hot spots”

TUBALL™ for SMC COMPOSITES
PRODUCT

Anti-static SMC composites for using in electronic equipment

REQUIREMENTS
* Volume resistivity of 10⁶–10⁹^{} Ω∙cm
* Permanent and stable level of resistivity   
TUBALL™ SOLUTION

6 wt.% of conductive carbon black as a conductive additive was replaced with
0.2 wt.% of TUBALL™ MATRIX 204

KEY BENEFITS
* Permanent and stable anti-static properties without “hot spots”
* Resistivity is independent of humidity
* Wide range of colors is available
* Clean manufacturing process without carbon black powder or dust
* Original flame retardancy is maintained
